definitions: To begin an activity or process with little progress or success.
To experience initial difficulties or a lack of momentum at the beginning of something.
examples: The new project got off to a slow start due to unexpected technical issues.
Despite getting off to a slow start, the team eventually caught up and won the game.
Many businesses get off to a slow start before finding their rhythm.
lemma: get off to a slow start
source: get off to a slow start
